_about: Intentional exceptions for tests/all.html's contract scan. Each entry is  name: reason. Keep reasons honest; an entry here hides a finding. Anything NOT listed here fails the build.

emittedNoListener.player:xp: documented broadcast in DESIGN §13 (payload { xp, xpNext, gained }); the HUD polls state, so no consumer is needed
emittedNoListener.loot:dropped: documented broadcast in DESIGN §13 for other systems / harnesses; nothing consumes it yet
emittedNoListener.echo:rise: documented broadcast in DESIGN §13 (banner reads entity state instead)
emittedNoListener.boss:blackout: documented broadcast in DESIGN §13; engine/UI have no hook for it yet
emittedNoListener.scavenger:race: documented broadcast in DESIGN §13; UI toast comes from scavenger:appear
emittedNoListener.flow:start: DESIGN §15 Q5: redundant with flow:chain/flow:trigger, kept for the old handover
emittedNoListener.milestone:reached: R12 #8 documented notification; the Journal reads getMilestones() directly
emittedNoListener.settings:changed: documented in DESIGN §11 as emitted by the UI for anyone who wants it
emittedNoListener.town:warmed: documented in DESIGN §10; the engine reads flags.warmth directly each frame (engine/rift.js)
